source: Reported usage in durable autoplay_gpu_result question responses, linked by GPU source span and retained native context/clock mapping.
duplicate_rule: Count a job/question response once. Reused direction proposals are not new inference. Shared assessments are allocated to the earliest matching retained segment.
unknown_rule: Missing usage or missing context/clock attribution is null, never zero or estimated from FPS.
prompt_token_note: Server-reported input accounting, including its image representation; not newly computed uncached tokens, cost, VRAM or GPU time.
